Gibbs-energy steps transcribed from the printed DeltaG diagram of Q8-3 (T8_page-3.png / p.74): CO branch -0.04, +0.02, +0.16, -0.36, -0.22, +0.1 eV; H2 branch +0.756, +1.832, -0.168, -1.14 eV, signed per the printed y-axis.

Physical principle (answer-blind, trusted general law): photon energy E = hc/lambda decreases with wavelength, and a more energetic photon drives the CO2-to-CO sequence (net endergonic deficit 0.14 eV, lambda <= 1097 nm) more completely against the competing H2 branch (whose largest step is the +1.832 eV photo-electron transfer), so chi(H2) is monotone decreasing in photon energy; every condition is realised by exactly one bar and each bar by one condition.
Nominal LED wavelengths used only for ordering: blue < green < red; exact peak values are not needed for the classification.
